# Sprint or cycle planning — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens when the group sets a sprint goal, considers capacity, pulls
backlog work, or uses explicit commitment language.

## What to extract

- Capture the stated sprint goal, or say that none was explicit.
- List committed items with owner, sizing, dependencies, and readiness only
  when discussed.
- Record capacity constraints, deferred items and reasons, ordering, and risks.

## Missing topics worth noting

Note commitments without readiness, capacity, ownership, or a clear goal when
those omissions affect the plan.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not turn a candidate backlog item into a commitment or invent capacity from
velocity language alone.
